label: Likely smoke direction
disclaimer: Simple wind model: it follows the forecast wind from your field. It is not a smoke dispersion model.
summary: NASA satellites saw 256 fires in India in the last day (935 satellite detections).
What was burning: 67 farm fires, 12 industrial, 67 in built-up areas, 61 forest, 26 grassland, 23 unknown.
While burning, these fires give off about 8,517 kg of PM2.5 an hour. Most toxic: fire F158 (13.8 km³ of air poisoned per hour, very high).
Their smoke will likely reach 902 villages, 839 towns, 112 schools and colleges and 363 hospitals and clinics.
Bisoi (town): smoke from 23 fires, since about 2:25 pm.
Purulia (city): smoke from 21 fires, since about 6:20 am.
Gorumahisani (town): smoke from 18 fires, since about 11:15 am.
notes: Around Punjab and Haryana smoke paths list villages, schools and hospitals; elsewhere in India they list cities and towns only.
